en: Sepia-toned photograph showing an indoor linen or supplies room, likely in a hospital or military facility. Shelves in the background are stacked neatly with folded towels, sheets, and bedding. In the foreground, a woman in a white nurse's uniform and veil with a small cross emblem sits at a table beside a man in a dark uniform; both are handling folded linens. Behind them stand another woman in dark civilian clothing and a man in a light military-style uniform and cap, wearing a dark armband, gesturing toward piles of folded fabric on a ladder or rack. The setting and clothing suggest an early 20th‑century wartime or institutional environment.
